lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots is organized into vertical columns. Posterior to the gill slits, columns contain between 4 and 6 distinct local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with horizontal spot alignments to form a series of rectangular grid nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance spots, primarily clustered near the anterior base and leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae individuals clustered near the ventral surface and trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
